headline: Takaful Malaysia Posts Highest Quarterly Profit in Five Years, Declares Dividend
summary: Syarikat Takaful Malaysia Keluarga Berhad posted its highest quarterly profit in five years and declared a 20.5 sen dividend.
why: Earnings and dividend distributions by major insurance operators offer insights into financial sector resilience and shareholder return policies.
